items.name: Polynomial.hasseDeriv
items.type: {R : Type u_1} [Semiring R] (k : ℕ) : Polynomial R →ₗ[R] Polynomial R

items.name: Polynomial.hasseDeriv_zero'
items.type: {R : Type u_1} [Semiring R] (f : Polynomial R) : (Polynomial.hasseDeriv 0) f = f

items.name: Polynomial.natDegree_hasseDeriv_le
items.type: {R : Type u_1} [Semiring R] (p : Polynomial R) (n : ℕ) : ((Polynomial.hasseDeriv n) p).natDegree ≤ p.natDegree - n

items.name: Polynomial.hasseDeriv_X
items.type: {R : Type u_1} [Semiring R] (k : ℕ) (hk : 1 < k) : (Polynomial.hasseDeriv k) Polynomial.X = 0

items.name: Polynomial.hasseDeriv_eq_zero_of_lt_natDegree
items.type: {R : Type u_1} [Semiring R] (p : Polynomial R) (n : ℕ) (h : p.natDegree < n) : (Polynomial.hasseDeriv n) p = 0

items.name: Polynomial.natDegree_hasseDeriv
items.type: {R : Type u_1} [Semiring R] [HasUniqueDiv R] (p : Polynomial R) (n : ℕ) : ((Polynomial.hasseDeriv n) p).natDegree = p.natDegree - n

items.name: Polynomial.hasseDeriv_apply_one
items.type: {R : Type u_1} [Semiring R] (k : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k) : (Polynomial.hasseDeriv k) 1 = 0

items.name: Polynomial.hasseDeriv_natDegree_eq_C
items.type: {R : Type u_1} [Semiring R] (f : Polynomial R) : (Polynomial.hasseDeriv f.natDegree) f = Polynomial.C f.leadingCoeff

items.name: Polynomial.hasseDeriv_C
items.type: {R : Type u_1} [Semiring R] (k : ℕ) (r : R) (hk : 0 < k) : (Polynomial.hasseDeriv k) (Polynomial.C r) = 0

items.name: Polynomial.hasseDeriv_coeff
items.type: {R : Type u_1} [Semiring R] (k : ℕ) (f : Polynomial R) (n : ℕ) : ((Polynomial.hasseDeriv k) f).coeff n = ↑((n + k).choose k) * f.coeff (n + k)
